note: No fact: the release names the Electronic Health Information System as a government investment that has brought digital platforms into disease surveillance, laboratories and imaging, but does not say what the system itself does, so it is unclassified. It also reports that a four-day digital health maturity assessment workshop (over 45 participants, over 30 indicators) recommended mapping existing solutions into a digital health strategy, which implies no such strategy existed at the date (workshop October 2023, release dated 2023-11-07), and that the ICT department works with the ministry on protecting citizen health records.
